column1: # Each line triages one ZAP baseline rule, with its reason. The scan targets the app in production
# mode with every sample installed (tools/demo.sh all --production; see .github/workflows/ci.yml).

column3: (Dangerous JS Functions) htmx ships a documented eval path that is disabled by allowEval:false and blocked by the CSP (no unsafe-eval)
(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens) by design: Fetch Metadata + Origin checks (tower-http CsrfLayer) and SameSite=Lax cookies; tested by cross_site_posts_to_every_unsafe_route_are_403
(Insufficient Site Isolation Against Spectre) COEP is deliberately unset: require-corp breaks third-party embeds; COOP and CORP are set
(Storable and Cacheable / Non-Storable Content) informational: public pages and /static are meant to be cacheable; kernel pages are no-store
(Authentication Request Identified) informational: ZAP found the login and sign-up forms (POST /session/password, /registration); no vulnerability
(Session Management Response Identified) informational: ZAP found a session-like cookie (e.g. __Host-login_browser from POST /login_links: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax); no vulnerability
